To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the digital transformation in the basic education has been initiated, but the digital divides are still present and reinforced, and that there is a need to further develop the digital transformation in education to meet the digital futures of children.
the COVID 19 crisis has forced basic education to undergo an extensive digitalization, which has revealed a variety of digital divides and barriers that need to be addressed in the future.
COVID-19 pandemic has forced the basic education of children to undergo digital transformation, which has been successful in some cases and not so in others.
In summary, our research is concerned with
children, their digital futures and the basic education of them as well as the information management research and its role in the digital transformation of the basic education of children.
the digital transformation of the basic education of children in Finland, the digital divides emerging and the barriers reported along the transformation process.
how to best equip children with the skills and competencies needed in their digitalized future and how to best prepare them to take an active role in the shaping of their digital future.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the COVID 19 has forced schools and education of children to engage in an extensive digital transformation, but the digital transformation of education has been initiated by the pandemic and is still in progress.
information management research has to care about the digital transformation of the basic education of children and the digital divides emerging and reinforcing in this context.
the COVID 19 crisis has been an eye-opener for the importance of the basic education and the role of information management research in the context of the digital transformation of everyday life.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we need to acknowledge children and their digital futures, and we need to better understand the role of information management in this context.

information management research is not only about managing and organizing information, but it should also be about managing and organizing children and their basic education in order to ensure their digital futures.
the COVID 19 forced digitalization of the basic education of young generation is not sufficient for their digital future.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should not forget children in our digitalization efforts, as they are the future of the digital society.
we should better care about the basic education of children and the digital transformation of education in general.
the basic education of children and the young generation is a crucial part of the digital transformation that is currently taking place.
